classification.rationale: Glass-fiber-reinforced plastic sheet is a reinforced plastic sheet of heading 3921. Heading 3920 is excluded because it covers only unreinforced sheet. Ruling H87087 (in force) classified gel-coated fiberglass reinforced polyester sheet in 3921.90.40.90, and I followed it. The choice between the flexible line and the non-flexible 3921.90.50 line depends on the product's rigidity, which the description does not give.
